prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Journey Order: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet adoption selection so users customize their pet before creating or syncing an account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Custom Pet to Your Account", "body": "Sign in now to lock in your pet customization and ensure your desktop pet is safely backed up.", "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Adoption Certificate Overview: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet traits on one side and adoption confirmation details on the other.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Review your new companion's details and confirm adoption to bring them to your desktop."}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Setup Checklist Screen: Add an interactive checklist on the final intro screen detailing how to summon, minimize, hide, and talk to your desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Ready to Meet Your Companion!", "body": "Here is a quick overview of how to interact, minimize, or talk to your pet on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Master your desktop pet controls", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Quiz Flow: Introduce a interactive quick quiz flow on path selection to guide undecided users to the best pet creation option.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Find Your Ideal Companion Path", "body": "Answer two quick questions to match with the perfect pet adoption experience."}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Saved Pet Account Protection Headline: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize that signing in prevents pet data loss and restores existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Secure & Restore Your Pets", "body": "Creating or signing into your account ensures your pets and customizations are safely saved to the cloud and never lost."}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Custom Pet Creation Quality Assurance Copy: Add an explicit guarantee hint and fine-tuning badge during photo upload reassuring users they can adjust their pet appearance anytime.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Don't worry! You can fine-tune or regenerate your pet's appearance anytime for free.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlimited Fine-Tuning Guarantee", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Compact Path Options Layout: Switch path selection to a compact layout that simplifies decision-making and reduces visual clutter.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Select Your Pet Journey", "body": "Choose how you would like to create or pick your desktop pet companion."}}
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Interaction & Command Guide Copy: Rewrite home intro text to give explicit instructions on tray icons, right-click context menus, and chat keybindings.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet for controls, double-click to chat, or click the tray icon to hide/show anytime."}}
8: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Recovery & Multi-Account Hint: Add a prominent hint guiding returning users to use their original login provider to avoid creating duplicate empty accounts.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Tip: Use the same email or login provider you used previously to access all your existing pets instantly."}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Tray Sound Notification: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and audio sound prompts on the waiting screen when asset building completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will play a quick chime and alert you as soon as your desktop pet is ready to appear.", "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Chime when pet is ready", "action": "play"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering the sign-in step to occur after adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the adoption certificate into a two-column layout is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding an interactive setup checklist to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a quiz sub-flow to choose_path to help users decide is allowed under Rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy to emphasize account backup and security is allowed inside onboarding.
Onboarding copy mentions 'for free', which violates Rule 3's prohibition on mentioning prices, discounts, gifts, or free extras.
Switching choose_path to a compact layout is allowed inside onboarding.
Updating home_intro copy to explain controls and interaction instructions is allowed.
Adding a sign-in hint to prevent duplicate account creation is allowed.
Adding audio and notification ready prompts to the waiting screen is allowed inside onboarding.
